description.value: Cafe & Life Co. is a community-minded cafe that opened during the COVID-19 pandemic with a mission to reconnect the local neighbourhood over quality coffee. The Richmond location serves a full brunch menu alongside specialty coffee, pastries, and catering, with delivery available through Uber Eats and Fantuan. It has since expanded to a second Vancouver location, reflecting a growing loyal following.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands at 15m; rack at 28m; rack at 30m; rack at 42m; rack at 50m; rack (covered) at 57m; rack at 95m; rack at 100m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, multi-location cafe with a Richmond branch at #150 - 6833 Buswell St, matching OSM. The /services/ page explicitly lists the Richmond phone (+1 (236) 235-0136) and address, corroborating OSM tags. Online ordering via Uber Eats and Fantuan is listed for Richmond, confirming takeout availability; no explicit evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: The website global header consistently displays the Vancouver location address (#117 - 511 W 7th Ave) and phone (+1 (604) 336-9888) rather than the Richmond location's details, which could mislead visitors. The Richmond-specific contact info is confirmed only on the /services/ page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active cafe with confirmed Richmond location; brunch menu, coffee, and online ordering make it a practical stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: expanded to a second Vancouver location, reflecting a growing loyal following
